journeys.name: Search and Apply for an Apprenticeship
journeys.description: The user searches for apprenticeship vacancies, reviews details, and applies for a vacancy.

journeys.name: Complete and Submit an Apprenticeship Application
journeys.description: The user completes all sections of the application and submits it.

journeys.name: Complete Equality and Diversity Questions After Application
journeys.description: After submitting an application, the user answers equality and diversity questions.

journeys.name: Manage and Withdraw Apprenticeship Applications
journeys.description: The user reviews, views, deletes, or withdraws their apprenticeship applications.

journeys.name: Manage Account Settings
journeys.description: The user updates their personal details, notification preferences, or requests account deletion.

journeys.name: Browse Apprenticeships by Interests or Location
journeys.description: The user browses apprenticeship vacancies by interests or location to view search results.

journeys.name: Request Account Deletion
journeys.description: The user requests account deletion, withdraws applications if needed, and confirms deletion.

journeys.name: Unsubscribe from Saved Search Notifications
journeys.description: The user unsubscribes from saved search notifications and receives confirmation.
